authority.objective: Independently qualify the protected temporal-enforcement correction (D-07) at the frozen heads: purpose-observation deadline anchoring, cached-purpose observations, delayed dispatch, clock and deadline boundaries, unchanged grant/identity/mandate behavior, historical predecessor evidence, refusal outcomes and absence of unauthorized external effects; issue a bounded verdict.

allowedActions: Read the frozen subject and the listed sources
Define and execute the qualifier's own oracle against the exact frozen heads in a clean environment
Run the subject's existing tests as evidence-gathering where the qualifier selects them

Publish the report to the designated location

Modifying the subject sources, the builder expectations or any frozen oracle to obtain green
Paid or real-environment execution without specific authorization
Network or external effects, publication, release, deployment, merging
Qualifying a revision other than the frozen heads

acceptance.riskRationale: Prescribed independent qualification of a governance-critical, authority-bearing boundary at a frozen candidate; read-only against the subject, no production effect.
successConditions: At the predecessor (CP 061a986): anchor_deadline_to_inputs=True, no PolicyBinding, class bound 30 s, purpose observation accepted at age 30 s with a 29 s stall is dispatched (age 59 s); at the frozen head the same fixture and the cached-purpose snapshot are refused by the existing check_expired_before_dispatch; strict boundary at the remaining-bound edge, one second inside and outside (F3-B 1)
Grant status, identity and mandate anchoring unchanged; flag False byte-identical to before; reversible/irreversible classes; post-reversal window (F3-B 2)
Outage extensions never raise a narrowed ceiling; the cached-snapshot bound is the recorded bound (F3-B 3)

The correction only adds a min to the deadline: for any input the new deadline <= the old, and anything accepted by the new code is accepted by the old (property-style, not only the 124-case builder grid) (F3-B 4)

No new reason code; profile dump, approval_commitment, catalogue_digest, persisted decision schema and refusal evidence fields unchanged; monotonic and wall-clock-stepped-back guards unchanged (F3-B 5)

The destination apply is never called after the deadline refusal (F3-B 6); the only protected-file change is the authorized one with the new hash recorded and the superseded characterization tests mapped to successors citing the original results (F3-B 7); profile-bearing families and policy_binding_unsupported unchanged (F3-B 8)

clauses.requiredBehavior: Distinguish implementation inspection, independent qualification, competent certification and final integration; preserve independence wherever required.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Fit an oracle to implementation or substitute developer tests.
clauses.binding: Define and run the qualifier's own scope and oracle; the builder expectations are a minimum and are not the test selection; no developer test substitutes for a qualification case.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Retain consequential decision ancestry, rejected alternatives, objections, adverse findings and supersession where legitimately relevant, subject to privacy and retention limits.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Delete, relabel, overwrite or silently rescore failures.
clauses.binding: Keep every adverse result with its original raw output (including the 41 known environmental baseline failures and their causes); never rescore, relabel or edit a frozen oracle to obtain green.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Bind claims to exact source, configuration, governing context and transition evidence; reconstruct authoritative pathways when deterministic execution replay is impossible.
clauses.binding: Qualify only the frozen heads in Inputs; evidence from the pre-merge branch heads 5ffd0ae, 4adb84b, b8fbe95, a1de48c, 55488d2 is not transferred to main without a recorded identity argument.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Optimize authorization-to-independently-qualified outcome; distinguish lifecycle evidence.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Treat PR counts, green CI or documents as delivery or qualification.
clauses.binding: Report delivery state precisely (merged, developer-tested, independently qualified or not); green CI, documents and PR counts are never reported as qualification.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Separate contribution, inspection, qualification, certification and integration according to risk and governing independence requirements.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Self-certify generated work or treat nominal human involvement as sufficient authority.
clauses.binding: The qualifier must be separate from the implementation builder (Lead Builder and its workers); report contribution, inspection, qualification, certification and integration as separate roles; a builder-spawned reviewer is not independent.
